correctness.rationale: Exact equality partitions and induced labeled adjacency diagrams give all and only complete quantifier-free tuple types. Proper induced subsets of a cycle are disjoint path runs with the necessary and sufficient gap condition n-j>=r; selecting the full vertex set yields (n-1)!/2 labeled cycle graphs. The EGF counts path-forest structures, the positive component layers prove strict type-count increase for every n<2k and constancy from 2k, and dihedral freeness on tuples with >=3 distinct values gives the exact orbit count. The standalone checker independently evaluated concrete cycle graph assignments and dihedral orbits. Finite checks are corroboration, not a general proof.

value.rationale: A natural model-theoretic invariant—the number of definable k-ary relations—is solved uniformly for finite cycles. The attained 2k stabilization threshold and exact floor(n/2)+1 first-separation arity answer a precise expressivity/reconstruction question, while the 2^{-Theta(n^{k-1})} scarcity among automorphism-invariant relations quantifies a genuine logical limitation. These are not merely the already known linear-forest counts; they involve a new two-parameter cycle profile and inverse cutoff.
